name: The Awakened Instinct
visual_description: Squatting, semi-feline horror with rows of teeth and a single enormous eye. A hybrid of prey and predator.
meaning: When fear learns to evolve. Knowledge armed with hunger.
existential_reflection: **Mizontresh once tried to engineer empathy in machines like this.** Instead, I made something that felt threat but not compassion. It hunted kindness out of suspicion.
